items.title: Microsoft says AI didn’t break Outlook — its own network upgrade did
items.summary: No one has confirmed what caused the Microsoft outage that took down Outlook and Copilot, and nothing links it to layoffs or AI, but it's not the first time Microsoft's own changes broke its apps.

items.title: Anthropic IPO to test Wall Street's faith in AI as skepticism mounts
items.summary: Anthropic seeks a valuation of approximately $1.3 trillion to $1.4 trillion.

items.title: Credo Technology Group vs. Marvell Technology: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: Credo's revenue surged past 160% in the latest twelve months, but Marvell's $9.5 billion scale and heavier debt load tell a very different story for investors.

items.title: C3.ai vs. SentinelOne: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: C3.ai's revenue fell sharply over the past year while SentinelOne kept expanding, but their valuations tell very different stories for investors.

items.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman Says There’s a Huge Disconnect in Wall Street’s Expectations for Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Alphabet
items.summary: Wall Street expects the hyperscalers to keep up their heavy capital expenditures, but it's worried that the revenue growth they are expecting to result from that spending might not show up.

items.title: Why the Microsoft Outage Came at the Worst Possible Time for the Stock
items.summary: Microsoft says services are being restored after a global office outage hit users across the world.

items.title: Harvard Cut Nvidia by a Third and Bought AMD
items.summary: Harvard's endowment rotated inside AI chips just before a brutal selloff hit one of them. Since then, the two stocks have moved very differently, and a closer look at the filing shows who really came out ahead.

items.title: SpaceX Hollows Out Its AI Video Division. Elon Musk Now Has Different Priorities
items.summary: A quiet round of layoffs just gutted one of Elon Musk's flashiest AI products, months after he vowed to double down on it. The retreat could hand a rival with deep pockets and a giant video platform exactly the opening it needs.
